sloka: स ददर्श महात्मानं किरीटिनमरिन्दमम्।शोणिताप्लुतसर्वाङ्गं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ।। ६.६७.१२५ ।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa mahātmānaṁ kirīṭinamarindamam।śoṇitāplutasarvāṅgaṁ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahābalam ।। 6.67.125 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon, Kumbhakarna endowed with terrific valour like God of Death hurled towards Rama a mountain peak whirling it round which split.
